setup_name: Size-banded gap fill entered at historical MAE zone
time_of_day: open through day; fill expected by close
universe_filter: opening gap within a mid-size band (Bund: 6-15 ticks); ignore tiny gaps that inflate fill rates
conditions: Open gaps vs prior close within the size band
Historical fill rate for that band is high (his figure ~82% by close)
Price first moves further away from prior close (adverse to the fill)
entry_trigger: Fade toward the gap fill once the adverse move reaches the typical MAE zone of past filled gaps (Bund up-gaps: mode ~11 ticks, ~1 SD ~17 ticks beyond open)
stop: Beyond the 1-SD MAE level; if price punches through it the stat is abandoned
management: Stop trading the stat once adverse excursion exceeds the historical band
stated_edge: Gap fills in a mid-size band are frequent, but raw fill rates hide large drawdowns; using the MAE distribution of past fills gives a defined entry and stop
stated_stats: Bund gaps 6-15 ticks fill ~82% by close (~92% incl. tiny gaps); MAE mode 11 ticks, SD 17 ticks
mcf_translation: Daily+5-min bars: gap% = open/prior close-1 in a band (e.g. 0.3-1.0% for SPY/QQQ); compute historical distribution of max excursion from open before fill on fill days; enter limit fade at the median MAE, stop at ~70th-percentile MAE, target prior close, flat at 16:00

setup_name: Initial balance break as target, not entry
instrument: futures (Bund, DAX); applicable to index ETFs
time_of_day: after initial balance forms (he uses first 2 hours for Bund; 1 hour elsewhere)
conditions: Initial balance (first 60 or 120 min range) complete
One side of IB not yet broken
A separate entry signal at a buyer/seller area exists
entry_trigger: Separate supply/demand or volume-profile entry; the untested IB extreme is used only as the profit target
stated_edge: One side of the IB breaks on almost every day, so an unbroken extreme is a likely magnet; alone it has no entry or R:R
stated_stats: one IB side broken ~98% of days (his stat)
mcf_translation: 5-min bars: compute 09:30-10:30 range; measure % of days either extreme is taken out; use as target for other entries (e.g. VWAP pullback) and test target hit rate

setup_name: Supply/demand zone with volume-profile HVN entry
conditions: Multi-timeframe map: 60-min big picture, 15-min medium, 3-min execution
Zone where trapped traders likely want out (supply/demand area aligned with high-volume node or rotation point)
Strong zone: resting limit; weaker zone: need at least 2 of 4 checklist confirmations
Reward to first target >= 1.5R
entry_trigger: Limit at strong zone, or 3-min confirmation at weaker zone
stop: 2 ticks beyond the far side of the HVN / rotation point (Bund ~5-10 ticks, avg ~6)
management: Fixed % risk per trade; smaller size if zone is wider
stated_edge: Areas where many traders are positioned produce reactions; stops placed beyond them are protected by that positioning
data_needed: volume profile (approximable from bar volume), futures data
mcf_translation: Build a rolling volume-by-price histogram from 5-min bars over prior N days; flag HVNs; long on first touch of an HVN below price in a 60-min uptrend, stop 0.1% beyond node, target prior swing; require 1.5R

setup_name: Flying pigs: short the backside of gapping junk microcaps
time_of_day: pre-market scan; entries from open onward after the high is in
universe_filter: low-priced, cash-burning/dilutive microcaps gapping up ~30-100% on fluffy PR or no news; pre-market volume several times (e.g. +400%) the 20-day average; prior runner on a saved watchlist
conditions: Stock on curated list of former runners with weak fundamentals
Large pre-market gap up with heavy relative volume
Move has topped: high-of-day rejection or loss of VWAP (backside)
entry_trigger: Short on VWAP break/crack or rejection off the high of day; front-side shorts done only with small size and scaling
stop: Above high of day / recent rejection high (sized small; repeated small stop-outs accepted)
target_or_exit: Hold for the fade (no specific target given)
management: Scale in; small size; willing to re-enter several times after small losses
stated_edge: Promoted/dilutive microcap spikes are not supported by fundamentals and tend to fade once buying exhausts
data_needed: low-priced stock universe, pre-market volume, short borrow availability, news/PR flag
mcf_translation: Daily+5-min bars: gap >30%, price <$10, premarket/early rvol >4; after 10:00, short on first 5-min close below VWAP after making HOD; stop above HOD; exit at close or 2R; check borrow realism

setup_name: Short the multi-day parabolic junk run at the intraday turning point
universe_filter: low-quality stock up several hundred percent over ~3 days (e.g. 1 to 5) on heavy unusual volume
conditions: Thesis: extended junk name will collapse 30-50%
Wait for a turning point on 1-5 min charts, volume and tape rather than shorting early in the run
Keep risk small until the reversal confirms
entry_trigger: Discretionary turning-point read (failed push, volume climax, tape shift); add once the turn confirms
stop: Above the turning-point high (risk kept small pre-confirmation)
target_or_exit: Ride the fade into the close
management: Starts small, presses size after confirmation; trails using VWAP
stated_edge: Hype-driven extensions without fundamentals collapse; timing avoids being run over
stated_stats: one of his best plays (no numbers)
data_needed: small-cap universe, borrow availability, tape/Level 2 for timing
mcf_translation: Daily bars: 3-day return >150%, price <$10; intraday short on first 5-min lower high below VWAP after 10:00; stop above HOD; exit 15:55

setup_name: Open-to-close trend capture with VWAP trail
universe_filter: catalyst stocks with unusual volume and volatile movement (biotech, IPOs, growth tech)
conditions: Stock opens and trends one way all day (opens high closes low, or vice versa)
Price holds on the correct side of VWAP
entry_trigger: Early in the session once direction is clear
stop: Trail: exit when price breaks VWAP
target_or_exit: Journal rule: take partial profits when the move extends a set number of standard deviations from the opening range; otherwise hold to close
management: VWAP trailing stop; partial profit at an opening-range-based SD multiple
stated_edge: The meat of a catalyst stock's move is the open-to-close trend
mcf_translation: 5-min bars on gap/rvol in-play names: enter in direction of first 30-min move if price is on that side of VWAP; exit on 5-min close across VWAP; partial at OR-high + k*OR-range (k=2); else exit 15:55

setup_name: Pre-market ARCA low offer on OTC stocks (historical glitch)
universe_filter: OTC pump-type stocks with unusual order flow, no news
conditions: Pre-market ARCA offers 10-20% below prior close with no news
Market makers' bids (not tradable until open) still at prior close
entry_trigger: Buy the discounted ARCA offers pre-market
target_or_exit: Sell to market makers right at the open near prior close
management: Exit immediately at open to avoid liquidity bottlenecks
stated_edge: Hybrid OTC market structure allowed stale/irrational pre-market prints that reverted at the open
stated_stats: worked ~2 years, a few times a month; later disappeared
data_needed: OTC pre-market quotes by venue; structure no longer exists
mcf_translation: Not applicable; general idea = buy irrational pre-market dislocations from prior close in names without news, exit at open (could check listed small caps with premarket data)

conditions: Daily cash price persistently above the prompt futures month
Implies storage operators will delay injection
entry_trigger: Position for the market consequence of the spread (fundamental read of term structure)
target_or_exit: Held up to ~3 months or until spread goes to delivery
stated_edge: Calendar spreads reveal how physical players will act before outright price does
mcf_translation: Not mappable to stock bars; ETF analogue would require futures term-structure data (e.g. UNG roll yield)

setup_name: Calendar spread mean reversion from multi-SD extremes
conditions: Spread several standard deviations from its mean
Belief that it will revert
entry_trigger: Scale in without trying to pick the exact extreme
stop: Implicit: position small enough to tolerate another multi-SD move
target_or_exit: Return to mean; holding up to ~3 months
stated_edge: Spreads tend to revert; small size allows staying in through further dislocation
mcf_translation: Analogue: pairs/ratio z-score mean reversion on correlated ETFs using daily bars (e.g. XLE/USO ratio z>3, scale in)

setup_name: Second-test support/resistance with layered limit orders ('fishing nets')
instrument: FX, index CFDs; adaptable to ETFs/stocks on daily bars
conditions: Clear level (often round number) that has been hit once and bounced
Price returns for the second test (he considers the second test the strongest; repeated tests weaken a level)
entry_trigger: Resting buy limit at the level plus a second limit slightly beyond it to catch the overshoot/stop run; qualifies if price fails to close beyond the level
target_or_exit: Ride for a 1000+ pip trend; R:R aims 1:3 minimum, 1:5 to 1:8 preferred
management: Initial risk 0.25%; add 0.5-0.75% after ~100 pips profit; trail with 8/21 EMA rule
stated_edge: Reversal entries at strong levels give small stops and very large R when a trend starts
stated_stats: win rate ~32%; occasional trends of 1000-4000 pips
mcf_translation: Daily bars on ETFs/large caps: identify swing low touched once (pivot), place limit at that level on 2nd approach and a 2nd limit 0.5 ATR below; stop 1.5 ATR below; exit via 8/21 EMA trail; measure R distribution

setup_name: Bearish/bullish rectangle: enter at the range edge in trend direction
universe_filter: pairs in a strong prior trend
conditions: Strong prior trend on daily/weekly
Several weeks of sideways range with well-defined support and resistance
Volatility contraction (narrowing candles) suggests coiling
entry_trigger: Short near range resistance in a downtrend (long near support in an uptrend) instead of on the breakout; for unclear direction in a coil, straddle with stop orders both sides
stop: Just beyond the entry-side edge of the range (small stop)
target_or_exit: Trend continuation after the eventual breakout (often after a stop run)
stated_edge: Entering at the range edge instead of after breakout gives the smallest stop and best R:R; compression precedes expansion
mcf_translation: Daily bars: prior 60-day trend (close vs 50-day SMA slope), then 15-25 day range with range/ATR contraction; enter limit at range edge in trend direction, stop 0.5 ATR beyond, trail per EMA rule

setup_name: Two-stage 8/21 EMA trailing stop for trend trades
conditions: Position at least ~100 pips (≈1-2 ATR) in profit
stop: Trail behind 8 EMA with a buffer and a round-number level between stop and EMA; once ~200 pips are locked in, freeze stop until 21 EMA catches up, then trail behind 21 EMA
target_or_exit: Stopped out by pullback through the trailing EMA
management: Checked every day or two; no discretionary profit taking
stated_edge: Gives trends room while removing emotional profit-snatching
mcf_translation: Exit module for daily swing setups: after +1 ATR, stop = 8EMA - buffer; after locked gain >= 2 ATR, hold stop until 21EMA exceeds it, then stop = 21EMA - buffer

setup_name: Short the sympathy plays when the lead runner reverses
time_of_day: pre-market planning; entries on spikes after open
universe_filter: sector momentum theme (e.g. shippers) with one lead runner and several low-float, dilution-prone sympathy names up 30%+ on no fundamental news
conditions: Clear lead stock ('head of the snake') driving the sector
Pick the relatively weakest sympathy name
Lead stock starts to reverse (fails, breaks down)
entry_trigger: Short the sympathy name at pre-planned resistance spikes / when the leader reverses
stop: Exit when the leader makes new highs again (thesis invalid); automatic stop on half the position
target_or_exit: Hold for multi-day fade back toward pre-run levels; partial covers
management: If closing below VWAP and near lows, hold overnight and cover 1/3-1/2 to lock gains; re-short higher if squeezed
stated_edge: Sympathy names have no reason to be up beyond the leader and often need to raise money; when the leader breaks, they collapse
stated_stats: best and most profitable setup (no numbers)
data_needed: sector/theme mapping, small-cap universe, borrow availability, SSR status
mcf_translation: Daily+5-min bars: define sector group; leader = top gainer in group with rvol>5; sympathy = other group members up >20% with float/price filters; short sympathy on first 5-min bar when leader closes below its VWAP; stop if leader makes new HOD; hold overnight if sympathy closes below VWAP, exit day 3 close

setup_name: Model-premium entry, then in-play hedge to lock profit
time_of_day: pre-event entry; exits ~15-20 min into play
universe_filter: only highly liquid events (e.g. top-league football with $10-20M matched)
conditions: Model fair price vs market price shows at least ~25% premium
No dominant qualitative factors (derbies etc.)
Stake proportional to event liquidity
entry_trigger: Take position pre-event when premium criterion met
stop: Hedge out in play to cap loss (bad trade typically loses 20-30% of stake)
target_or_exit: After a favourable price move (e.g. goal), lay the other side to lock profit; ~95-97% of trades closed before the result
stated_edge: Early markets are inefficient vs a sport-specific model; locking gains removes outcome variance
stated_stats: fund +220% since 2010, 77.8% positive months, worst month -6.4%
mcf_translation: Transferable idea only: require model edge threshold before entry and lock profit once a fast favourable move occurs (e.g. exit half at +1R within first 30 min)

setup_name: Event-conditional switch between momentum and mean-reversion
instrument: futures (rates, ags, metals); applicable to index ETFs
universe_filter: markets with a scheduled report and identifiable crowded positioning
conditions: Scheduled release (e.g. retail sales, crop report)
If the release surprises versus consensus (especially against crowded positioning): favour momentum/trend strategies
If the release is in line: favour mean-reversion strategies
entry_trigger: Per the underlying strategy chosen (momentum breakout or fade)
management: Leverage allocated across strategy families by regime
stated_edge: Surprises cause repositioning trends; in-line data leaves range behaviour intact
data_needed: economic calendar with consensus and actuals; futures data
mcf_translation: On CPI/NFP/FOMC days for SPY/QQQ: classify surprise via first 15-min range vs 20-day avg first-15 range (proxy); if large, run ORB continuation; if small, run VWAP/OR mean-reversion; compare to running each unconditionally
